instruction.text: 20 people want to get onto the minibus. The minibus can only fit 13 people. How many people won’t fit in the minibus?
Elijah builds a tower that is 17 blocks tall. He had to borrow 8 of the blocks from Freya. How many blocks in the tower belong to Elijah?
15 cars are waiting at the traffic lights. When the light turns green, 7 cars drive away. How many cars are left waiting at the traffic lights?
Niran makes a pile of 18 plates. His mum takes away 6 to serve dinner. How many plates are left in Niran’s pile?
Ramona sees a group of 6 cats down her street. Then she notices 4 more cats hidden in the middle of the group. How many cats are there in total?
Casper collects 13 worms from his garden. He brings them to his neighbour Dohyun, who has collected 9 worms. How many worms do the boys have in total?
Lucia counts that she has 16 toy dolls. Her mum donates 9 of them to a charity shop. How many dolls does Lucia have left?
Iris wants to collect 20 special coins. She already has 6 coins. How many more coins does Iris need to reach her goal?
